prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity unapproved design direction preview for Signal Lock, a playable workshop web game. Generate exactly one landscape image, approximately 1440x1000, clean straight-on screenshot without browser chrome.
Primary request: Design direction "Character press": bold screen-print workshop meets chunky interchangeable toy moulds. Visually audacious, utterly clear actual gameplay interface. Confident oversized grotesk typography, flat printed colour divisions and slightly physical 3D toy characters and rotary knobs. No marketing content.
Composition: Edge-to-edge desktop UI. Thin cream top bar says SIGNAL LOCK at left, SOLO REHEARSAL centered, ROUND 03 at right plus simple pause button. Narrow phase rail directly below reads OPEN / FIVE VOTERS / FROZEN / RESULT, with FROZEN clearly active in red-orange. Main upper region: left 70 percent is a large cobalt #254DDD assembly field, right 30 percent is a yellow #F5E84A timing and vote region. Lower 30 percent full-width cream #F6F1E4 controls band divided into three spacious equal control stations.
Left playfield: two generously separated chunky modular sculptural toy characters, appealing geometric moulded forms, not realistic animals. Left is green frog with yellow crown; right is light blue fox with red-orange headphones, visibly readable against cobalt. Both stand upright in parallel for instant comparison. Their moulded forms have separable head/body/accessory construction, mild toy material shading and physical depth with crisp silhouettes. Above characters precise large cream labels TARGET and YOUR SIGNAL. Under frog: FROG / GREEN / CROWN. Under fox: FOX / BLUE / HEADPHONES. Small SOLO PREVIEW label under TARGET. Keep field open with strong negative space and a small central connecting arrow. Not a photograph or screen mockup inside a device.
Right yellow region: enormous dark "04" occupies upper half, smaller bold "FROZEN" and "seconds remaining". Clear "LAST SCORE 1/3" beneath, because previous score rather than current character match. Compact "SIMULATED AUDIENCE" caption and three honest small vote-distribution strips labeled ANIMAL, COLOUR, ACCESSORY beneath. Each strip shows one dominant segment and minor competing segments. No confusing chart noise.
Lower cream band: large labels "Animal", "Colour", "Accessory", current values FOX, BLUE, HEADPHONES. Three oversized tactile rotary controls with dark ridged edges, cream faces and red-orange indicator marks, equally easy to operate. Each has left/right small arrow buttons. Keyboard hints under: "A / D", "J / L", "← / →". A thin lower footer reads "Turn the controls to match the target before zero." and has a compact "Messages" utility aligned right.
Colour palette: cobalt #254DDD, yellow #F5E84A, cream #F6F1E4, red-orange #EF583B, dark ink #172020. Green and light blue restricted to character identity and vote segments. Flat regions with strong boundaries, beautifully set compact typography, few minimal ink rules. No gradients except natural shading inside toy characters and knobs.
Constraints: User can understand target, their signal, time remaining and controls immediately. Layout is grounded in actual gameplay; future phone layout can stack scene and controls. All specified text spelled clearly. No generic cards, glassmorphism, neon, glow, gradients across surfaces, hamburger marketing navigation, slogan, giant logo, landing-page header, website hero, floating shapes, excessive dashboard data, device frame, inaccessible tiny labels, watermark. Make it feel like a vivid designed game instrument, not a poster.
approval: User: I have picked the impeccable's pick. Explicit approval of Character press preview, 2026-09-23.
